3614.title: Child answers leave duplicate parent questions pending
3614.rootCauseOneLine: Child settlement is scoped to its own interaction and thread; the separate parent question has no relationship that would clear it.
3614.proposedFix: Decide how to avoid or explicitly associate duplicate delegated questions and safely cancel them.
3614.caveats: Server lifecycle reproduced; no live provider or UI timing test. No simple fix without a product/contract decision.
